title: On explicit solutions to a class of quadratic BSDEJs driven by affine Volterra processes with jumps and applications
abstract: arXiv:2604.01300v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this paper we consider a class of quadratic BSDEs with jumps (quadratic BSDEJs) involving inhomogeneous affine Volterra processes and show that their solution can be reduced to solving a system of generalized inhomogeneous integral Riccati-Volterra ordinary differential equations with L\'evy jump compensators. This yields a rich and flexible class of quadratic BSDEJs that are analytically tractable, in the sense that their solutions are explicit up to the solution of an associated integral Riccati-Volterra ODE with L\'evy jump compensator. As an application, we provide analytically tractable solutions to the continuous-time Markowitz mean-variance portfolio selection problem within a multivariate class of affine Volterra models allowing jumps driven by an independent Poisson random measure. translated_title: 关于由带跳仿射Volterra过程驱动的一类二次BSDEJ的显式解及其应用
translated_abstract: 本文考虑一类涉及非齐次仿射Volterra过程的带跳二次倒向随机微分方程（二次BSDEJ），并证明其解可以归结为求解一组带Lévy跳补偿器的广义非齐次积分Riccati-Volterra常微分方程。由此得到一大类丰富且灵活、可解析处理的二次BSDEJ，即其解在求解相应的带Lévy跳补偿器的积分Riccati-Volterra常微分方程后即为显式解。作为应用，作者在允许由独立Poisson随机测度驱动的跳跃的多变量仿射Volterra模型类中，为连续时间Markowitz均值-方差投资组合选择问题提供了可解析处理的解。在这一具有无界随机系数的非马尔可夫、非半鞅市场框架中，经典的随机控制方法……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明了一类由带跳非齐次仿射Volterra过程驱动的二次BSDEJ的解可归结为求解带Lévy跳补偿器的广义非齐次积分Riccati-Volterra常微分方程，从而获得显式解，并将其应用于非马尔可夫、非半鞅市场下连续时间Markowitz均值-方差投资组合选择问题的可解析求解。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that solutions to a class of quadratic BSDEJs driven by inhomogeneous affine Volterra processes with jumps reduce to solving generalized inhomogeneous integral Riccati-Volterra ODEs with Lévy jump compensators, yielding explicit solutions and enabling analytically tractable treatment of the continuous-time Markowitz mean-variance portfolio selection problem in non-Markovian, non-semimartingale markets.
